newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hog prices seen mixed -dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hog prices seen mixed -dealers.

text.p: Midwest direct cash hog prices Tuesday were seen mixed, with some hogs likely selling at higher prices than Monday, and some lower, depending on where rain falls overnight and Tuesday in the Corn Belt, dealers said.
Rain was expected to delay harvesting, which could result in larger numbers of hogs coming to market.
Top prices for hogs delivered to the plant in Iowa and southern Minnesota were seen ranging from $51.00 to $52.00 per cwt, down $0.50 from Monday, sources there said.
